Bank Account Summary

The Bank Account Summary report provides an overview of all bank account balances.

Configure the report parameters to view bank account movements and balances.

Bank account

Select the bank or cash account you want to analyze.

This report shows all transactions affecting the selected account during the specified periods.

Use this report to review account activity, verify balances, and analyze cash flow patterns.

Periods

Define one or more date ranges to analyze account activity.

Add multiple periods to compare account movements across different time frames.

Common uses include month-over-month or year-over-year comparisons.

Show account codes

Enable this option to show account codes next to account names in the report.

Account codes help identify accounts quickly and are useful for mapping to external systems.

Exclude zero balances

Enable this option to hide accounts that have no activity or zero net change during the period.

This creates a cleaner report by focusing only on accounts with actual transactions.
